_doc: Where item models sit on a skeleton, in the bone's own axes (Godot and Blender agree: Y runs along the bone from head to tail, Z is the body's front for hanging and upright bones). offset in metres from the bone's head; rotation in degrees, XYZ order, turning the item's model axes (Godot: Y up the blade, Z the front) onto the bone. Read by src/actors/actor_body.gd and tools/blender/render/preview.py. Items are modelled with the grip (weapons), centre (shields) or head-bone base (helmets) at the origin.
